name: EisenVault
description_en: EisenVault is Argali Knowledge Services’ document-management offering, available as hosted or customer-server deployment. The current site also presents EisenVault One with its own user and administrator documentation. Both address indexed documents, access and routed work, but One’s documented permissions, restore and workflow conditions must not be assumed for every legacy EisenVault installation. Pricing is a tailored quote and the official page offers a trial without specifying its duration.
description_zh: EisenVault 是 Argali Knowledge Services 的文档管理产品，可采用托管或客户服务器部署。当前网站还介绍 EisenVault One，并有独立用户及管理员文档。两者均涉及索引文档、访问及流转，但不能把 One 文档中的权限、恢复和工作流条件套到每套旧 EisenVault 安装。价格按需求报价，官方页提供试用但未说明期限。

core_features.explanation_en: Cloud workflow options and custom implementation need scoping; One builder availability is environment-specific.
core_features.explanation_zh: Cloud 流程选项及定制实施需明确范围，One 构建器可用性依环境而定。

core_features.explanation_en: Access received through applicable role/group paths is combined.
core_features.explanation_zh: 适用角色及组路径授予的访问会组合。

core_features.explanation_en: Restoring old content makes a new current version without deleting newer history.
core_features.explanation_zh: 恢复旧内容会创建新当前版，不删除较新历史。

en: Evaluate a synthetic controlled drawing and its approval, access and recovery state in a named deployment.
zh: 在明确部署中评估虚构受控图纸及其审批、访问和恢复状态。
use_cases.basis: Editorial evaluation only; not customer adoption or measured business outcome.

Deployment.en: Cloud or customer-server EisenVault; One documentation is product-specific and builder availability is environment-qualified.
Deployment.zh: 云或客户服务器 EisenVault；One 文档专属该产品，构建器可用性附有环境条件。

steps.en: Confirm exact edition and production workflow availability, then define one synthetic drawing, roles, accepted revision and recovery outcome before requesting a deployment quote.
steps.zh: 确认精确版本及生产流程可用性，定义虚构图纸、角色、接受修订和恢复目标，再申请部署报价。

integrations.scope: Office/email/mobile and offline options documented; exact versions, connector keys, retries, limits and old-versus-One applicability unverified.

items.en: One builder production entry points are hidden by documented default; full software/hosting license, self-serve availability and legacy-to-One continuity remain unverified.
items.zh: One 构建器文档默认隐藏生产入口；完整软件托管许可、自助可用性及旧版至 One 连续性未核实。

license.scope: Open architecture and open-source infrastructure claims do not establish an EisenVault software source license. Commercial app privacy and Gmail add-on terms not substituted for DMS EULA.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Custom quote; free trial explicitly offered with duration and exact entitlement unverified. No public numeric fee adopted.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定制报价；明确提供免费试用，但期限和精确权益未核实。未采用公开数值费用。

sections.title_en: Choose the actual product before the evaluation record
sections.title_zh: 选定实际产品后再定义评估记录
sections.en:
The site offers Cloud and on-premises EisenVault, alongside the named One offering. One has dedicated documentation linked from the official .com site. Its product page promotes immediate self-service while another passage says instant onboarding is coming soon. This does not establish immediate account availability, a migration path or identical behavior across editions.

For an editorial pilot, use a synthetic controlled equipment drawing with an equipment ID, drawing number, owner and review status. First record the exact deployment and edition. Define whether success means finding an approved drawing, changing it or completing a review. Keep a source copy for comparison and identify how a downstream reader recognizes the correct revision. File-format storage support does not by itself prove native CAD editing or approval of engineering changes. No tenant, drawing, migration or trial was created.
sections.zh:
官网同时提供 Cloud、本地 EisenVault 及名为 One 的产品，并从正式 .com 网站链接 One 专门文档。One 产品页宣传即时自助使用，另一段又说即时开通即将推出，因此不能据此确立即时账户可用、迁移路径或各版本行为相同。

编辑建议的试点可用虚构受控设备图纸，设设备标识、图号、所有者及审查状态。先记录精确部署和版本，明确成功是找到获批图纸、修改，还是完成审查。应保留来源副本用于比较，并确定下游读者如何辨认正确修订。支持存储一种格式，不单独证明原生 CAD 编辑或工程变更已获批。本研究未创建租户、图纸、迁移或试用。

sections.title_en: A visible design guide does not promise a production entry point
sections.title_zh: 有设计指南不保证生产入口可用
sections.en:
EisenVault’s Cloud page describes configurable maker-checker routing and marks some escalation and observer capabilities as custom implementation. One’s Workflow Builder guide is more specific: staging/development expose its entry points, while production builds hide them; manual workflows can start only where the deployment exposes workflow routes. Resolve that deployment condition before promising a production approval process.

Within the documented One builder, Folder Trigger creates automated runs, attachments support a manual request and Blueprint mode saves a reusable template. Sequential approvals and parallel approvals have different completion rules; parallel thresholds count a group as one selected entity. The stop-on-rejection option is described for sequential steps. For the proposed drawing, define who must decide and what rejection means, then demonstrate the permitted production route on synthetic content. A published template is not proof of an executed or completed review. No builder, workflow, approval or notification was operated.
sections.zh:
EisenVault Cloud 页描述可配置制作者复核者流转，并将部分升级及观察者能力标为定制实施。One Workflow Builder 指南更具体：staging/development 显示入口，生产构建隐藏入口；手动流程只能在部署暴露路由处启动。承诺生产审批前必须解决这一条件。

在文档所述 One 构建器中，Folder Trigger 对应自动运行，附件对应手动请求，Blueprint 模式保存可复用模板。串行与并行审批有不同完成规则，并行人数阈值将一个组计为一个选定实体；拒绝即停选项针对串行步骤。建议图纸应确定谁必须决定、拒绝意味着什么，再用虚构内容演示允许的生产路由。模板已发布不证明审查已执行或完成。本研究未操作构建器、流程、审批或通知。

sections.title_en: Check every grant path in One
sections.title_zh: 检查 One 的每条授权路径
sections.en:
One’s permission guide combines rights from applicable direct, group, nested-group and content-role assignments. Restricting one assignment does not remove a right granted through another path. It also describes limited ancestor browsing when a user has access to a child but lacks normal parent visibility. Such navigation support is not a grant to every sibling document.

For the synthetic drawing, compare an editor with a read-only reviewer, including users who belong to two relevant groups. Check view, download, edit and approval separately on the item and its parent path. Then inspect a newly added child. Keep a record of which assignment supplies each required action. Do not apply these One semantics to an old installation without confirming its access model. Exact inheritance exceptions and security-administration combinations require the deployed configuration. No account, group or permission was modified.
sections.zh:
One 权限指南组合适用的直接、组、嵌套组及内容角色授权。限制一项授权，不会移除另一条路径授予的权利。指南还描述：用户可访问子项但没有常规父级可见性时，可有限浏览祖先路径；这不授予所有同级文档访问。

虚构图纸应比较编辑者与只读审查者，并包含同时属于两个相关组的用户。逐项检查文件及父路径的查看、下载、编辑和审批，再检查新加子项，记录每个目标动作由哪项授权提供。不能未经确认就将 One 语义套到旧安装；精确继承例外及安全管理组合需结合实际配置。本研究未修改账户、组或权限。

sections.title_en: Recover content, location and process state separately
sections.title_zh: 分别恢复内容、位置与流程状态
sections.en:
One’s older-version restore requires the appropriate permission and creates a new current version based on the chosen old content, preserving newer history. Its trash guide requires recovery enabled in the deployment and permission to view/restore; items remain for 30 days. Restore normally returns to the original path, but a missing parent can require another destination or block restoration. Metadata and permissions are preserved only where supported by that deployment.

For the proposed drawing, record the intended content, index values, access and review state before a recovery evaluation. Afterward, inspect each rather than assuming a restored file also recovered approvals, external links or every related record. Permanent removal cannot be undone through the documented trash action. Database backup or file replication is a different recovery mechanism, with its own scope. No restore, deletion or purge was run; post-purge recovery and full tenant reconstruction remain unverified.
sections.zh:
One 旧版恢复需相应权限，会按所选旧内容创建新当前版并保留较新历史。其回收站指南要求部署启用恢复且用户有查看恢复权限，项目保留 30 天。通常恢复原路径，但父级缺失可能需改选目的地或阻止恢复。元数据及权限仅在部署支持时保留。

建议图纸在评估恢复前，应记录目标内容、索引值、访问及审查状态，恢复后逐项检查，不能假定文件回来也恢复审批、外部链接和全部相关记录。文档化回收站动作不能撤销永久移除。数据库备份或文件复制是范围不同的恢复机制。本研究未执行恢复、删除或清除；清除后恢复及完整租户重建未核实。

sections.title_en: Enabled AI still needs user permission and source checking
sections.title_zh: 启用 AI 后仍需用户权限及来源核对
sections.en:
One’s AI settings control tenant availability for summarization, tagging, metadata extraction and search/Q&A. User roles can impose an additional requirement: metadata extraction is offered only when enabled for the tenant and permitted for the user. Those switches describe access to a feature, not its model provider, processing region, training policy or output accuracy.

For the synthetic drawing packet, ask which source pages a proposed extracted equipment ID came from and compare them before using the value to route work. Check permissions with the intended user rather than an administrator alone. Separate a generated summary from the approved instruction. Watermarks and annotations are also different from permanent removal of underlying content; inspect the actual exported rendition before sharing. The reviewed public pages do not establish the complete AI contract or every export behavior. No AI feature was enabled, document transmitted, output generated or file shared.
sections.zh:
One AI 设置控制摘要、标签、元数据提取和检索问答在租户中的可用性。用户角色还有额外要求：元数据提取需同时在租户启用并由用户权限允许。这些开关描述功能访问，不描述模型提供方、处理地区、训练政策或输出准确率。

虚构图纸包应追问提取设备标识来自哪些来源页，并在据此流转前比较。需通过目标用户而非只用管理员检查权限，区分生成摘要与获批说明。水印和批注也不同于永久移除底层内容，共享前应检查实际导出呈现。已读公开页未确立完整 AI 合同或每种导出行为。本研究未启用 AI、传送文档、生成输出或共享文件。

sections.title_en: Identify the hosting and restoration responsibility
sections.en:
On-premises documentation assigns security, backup and maintenance to the customer’s IT environment and lists database/storage options with some custom capabilities. Cloud security text describes AWS cross-region document replication and database backups to another location. Those statements do not establish the exact chosen tenant region, recovery time or a synchronized full application restore. The broad on-premises same-feature/mobile wording also needs reconciliation with the Cloud page’s mobile-only statement.

For the drawing pilot, establish the actual client, data center or server, offline-copy behavior and recovery owner. Test a representative restored packet, including metadata and access, before relying on a backup label. Confirm conflict handling before enabling offline editing and synchronization. An open architecture or software running on open-source platforms does not grant source rights to EisenVault itself. The app privacy page discusses user documents, error logs and service providers; it is not the complete hosting or software agreement. No infrastructure, mobile app, sync or backup was operated.
sections.zh:
本地部署文档将安全、备份及维护分配给客户 IT 环境，并列出数据库存储选项，其中部分能力需定制。Cloud 安全文字描述 AWS 跨地区文档复制及异地数据库备份，却未确立具体租户地区、恢复时间或同步完整应用恢复。本地页宽泛的相同功能和移动措辞，还需与 Cloud 页移动仅限云版本说明协调。

图纸试点需明确实际客户端、机房或服务器、离线副本行为及恢复责任人。依赖备份标签前，应验证含元数据和访问的代表性恢复包。启用离线编辑同步前需确认冲突处理。开放架构或运行于开源平台不授予 EisenVault 本身源码权利。应用隐私页涉及用户文档、错误日志及服务提供方，不是完整托管或软件协议。本研究未操作基础设施、移动应用、同步或备份。

sections.title_en: Use the official trial and quote conditions, with unknowns intact
sections.title_zh: 采用官方试用及报价条件并保留未知
sections.en:
The official pricing page offers a tailored quote by number of users, cloud/on-premises deployment and required features. It explicitly offers a free trial, contrary to the third-party no-trial claim found during discovery. It publishes neither a numerical amount nor a trial duration in the reviewed body. Do not adopt third-party starting prices or interpret the absence of a fee table as free production use.

For the proposed installation, ask the quote to distinguish the exact edition, storage/users, custom workflow capabilities, migration, support and any AI or third-party services. Obtain software and hosting terms covering the intended deployment, renewal, cancellation, export and deletion. The full DMS license was not established; the Gmail add-on terms are a separate scope and the app’s commercial label alone does not determine open-source status. One’s self-serve availability needs confirmation despite the documented guides. No form, support message, price request, purchase, installation or agreement acceptance was made.
sections.zh:
官方价格页按用户数、云或本地部署及所需功能提供定制报价，并明确提供免费试用，与发现阶段第三方无试用说法不同。已读正文没有数值金额或试用期限，不能采用第三方起价，也不能将没有价目表当作免费生产。

建议安装的报价应区分精确版本、存储用户、定制流程、迁移、支持，以及 AI 或第三方服务，并取得覆盖目标部署、续费、取消、导出和删除的软件托管条款。未确立完整 DMS 许可；Gmail 附加组件条款范围不同，应用商业标签本身也不能决定是否开源。尽管有操作指南，One 自助可用性仍需确认。本研究未提交表单、支持消息、询价、购买、安装或接受协议。

seo.title_en: EisenVault: Deployment Scope, One Permissions and Recovery Conditions
seo.title_zh: EisenVault：部署范围、One 权限及恢复条件
seo.description_en: Evaluate EisenVault with a controlled-drawing example, explicitly scoped One workflow availability, additive permissions, version/trash recovery and custom quotes.
seo.description_zh: 通过受控图纸样例、明确范围的 One 流程可用性、相加权限、版本回收站恢复及定制报价评估 EisenVault。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate EisenVault and the applicability of One documentation.
secondary_questions: Is the One workflow builder available in production?
Does old-version restore remove newer history?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no keyword-demand or ranking measurement.

research_gaps.en: No account/trial, server/app install, role/group edit, document/metadata operation, workflow, AI action, offline sync, email, share, quote, agreement acceptance, payment, backup, deletion or restore performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户试用、服务器应用安装、角色组编辑、文档元数据、流程、AI、离线同步、邮件、共享、询价、协议接受、支付、备份、删除或恢复。

research_gaps.en: Complete DMS/hosting license, current One activation/production routes, legacy migration, current runtime/database versions, workflow retry/reset, provider/model data terms, exact trash configuration, full restore/export and renewal/cancellation remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 完整 DMS 托管许可、当前 One 开通生产路由、旧版迁移、当前运行数据库版本、流程重试重置、提供方模型数据条款、精确回收站配置、完整恢复导出及续费取消未核实。

research_gaps.en: Cloud-only mobile statement conflicts with broad onprem feature text; One instant-use versus coming-soon onboarding retained. Root public reader failed but actual browser worked; linked official leaf pages read normally. No third-party prices/no-trial claims, source-license inference, security/compliance/performance or data-deletion guarantees adopted.
research_gaps.zh: Cloud 移动仅限云声明与本地宽泛功能文字冲突，保留 One 即时使用及开通即将推出差异。根地址公开读取器失败，但实际浏览器可用，官方叶页可正常读取。未采用第三方价格无试用说法、源码许可推断或安全合规性能和数据删除保证。
